scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mapgame.wasm','../public/mapgame.bin')"
scripts.build:cppwasm: node build-cpp.mjs && rustc --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type cdylib -C opt-level=z -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C panic=abort -C strip=symbols -o public/benchrs.bin rust/bench.rs
scripts.build:goban: cd golang && set GOOS=js&& set GOARCH=wasm&& go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../public/goban.wasm .
